body:
Restore the registered runbook interfaces and interrupted no-known inoculation recovery that block #1676's baseline.

- Refresh the reviewed Brevitas, check-runner and Hexaemeron-runner module pins. Read a named literal choice from the pinned module without importing it, and accept a literal help epilog. Expressions, aliases, ambiguous bindings and executable declarations still refuse. PR #1671 already refreshed Hypomnema's pin.
- Let only `done inoculate` reach the pending no-known recovery handler. When the ledger advanced before the state write, accept only the exact transaction edge bound by its marker. Ordinary mutations, changed runbook bytes and unrelated ledger transitions retain their refusals.
- Add current-contract recovery guards at both state-write windows, plus interface cases for the named mode and inert epilog. The restored joined lifecycle reaches an earlier alias refusal; retain that assertion and check the replacement owner's alias refusal independently. Both leave controller state and ledger unchanged.
- Refresh the changed source/result digests and their current projections. Re-tally the eleven byte-identical prompts against their original answers; only the evaluation tree binding changes, with no new model observation.

Before repair, the gate module ran 25 tests with 6 failures and 18 errors. The isolated completion-fsync recovery test failed at the dispatch preflight. The added current-contract guards reproduced the same refusal. After repair, all 27 gate tests, both current-contract recovery guards, the joined lifecycle and the source-binding guard pass. The commit gate passed 1,996 tests. The clean-checkout suppression check exited 0 with no suppressions; its repository analyser reported degraded coverage.

On signed commit `051addd73685a189cc9a982a43196760c2ae3928`, the complete Hexaemeron suite ran 3,345 tests with twelve workers: zero failures or errors, five skips and one expected failure. The declared check runner initially found three failing checks; the final full root suite, full Hexaemeron suite and clean-checkout suppression check clear those failures. The original aggregate report remains a preserved failed run.

Existing gate receipts continue to bind the exact adapter and CLI source bytes. Adopting a changed adapter uses the existing runbook-amendment path; this repair does not rewrite old receipts.

Closes #1673. Closes #1674.

title: Restore runbook interfaces and interrupted inoculation recovery
